Distinct second event: start of EHCVM-3 field preparation, 9 February 2026, cartographer and enumerator training under INSEED.
The SNDS-II 2020-2024 strategy document itself, adopted by the CNS on 27 August 2020 - the instrument, not commentary on it.
CNS 13th ordinary session, 30 June 2026: strategic orientations adopted for the national statistical system in support of the 2026-2031 roadmap.
Distinct second event: validation of the operational tools for the statistical visa, 7-9 July 2026, to go to the CNS for adoption.

Most recent authoritative publication of the national statistical yearbook series, compiled from sectoral administrative information systems and ministry returns. Also carries in-window movement (revised edition August 2026), so counted once as baseline.
The open data portal own post on the official launch of opendata.gouv.tg and geodata.gouv.tg on 19 December 2024 - the dated founding act of the programme.
Migration of the national Open Data Portal from ODP 1.0 to ODP 2.0 with SDMX modelling, 7-11 April 2026, World Bank funded via PHASAOC.
Distinct second event: the Observatoire national du numerique went live 13 November 2025, publishing digital-sector data with an annual report planned.

Distinct second event: Togo AI Lab using satellite imagery over agricultural plots to train maize and sorghum production forecasting models - the yield-forecast leg the baseline does not cover.
The MCC Threshold Program Grant Agreement itself, signed 14 February 2019 - the most formal US instrument bearing on Togo ICT sector.
MCC own page recording the August 2025 Board vote to terminate and the 18 December 2025 termination, with the ICT project committed and expended figures.
Distinct second event: US Embassy Lome AEIF 2025 grant for a Digital Young Entrepreneur Lab training 50 entrepreneurs in smartphone AI tools.
The government portal record of the Togo-Huawei strategic partnership protocol signed at FOCAC 2024 - the standing digital-specific Chinese instrument.

MOFCOM-organised seminar with a 31 July 2026 immersion visit by Togolese officials to the G60 science and technology corridor; the only in-window Chinese digital-field engagement with a Togolese primary record.
The Joint Programming Document for European cooperation with Togo 2021-2027, standing in place of a separate EU MIP and carrying the digital economy as a priority.

BGK financing of about 24 million euros for Cyber Defense Africa first phase under an EU EFSD+ guarantee, described by the EU Ambassador as the first EU-supported digital investment in Togo under Global Gateway.
Distinct second event: Africa Connect Digital Campus, 4.2 million euros EU and French funded, started 15 October 2025, covering Togo under Global Gateway.

Islamic Development Bank loan TGO 1024 (PARESI-2) funding digital feasibility studies for virtual laboratories at Lome, Kara and Atakpame - the only Gulf-headquartered financing of a digital component in Togo found.
India official bilateral inventory as at April 2026: lists every India-Togo MoU and all seven Lines of Credit, none of them ICT or digital, and records Cina Lawson February 2026 delegation.
India own press release on Cina Lawson high-level panel appearance at the India AI Impact Summit, 19 February 2026 - the one in-window India-Togo digital engagement.
